pages.text: The Runic Grimoire is a magic reference book covering runic magic systems in this pack. It documents rune inscription, runic tool upgrades, and enchantment interactions through the runic system.

$(bold)Note:$(/bold) If this is Primal Magic's Grimoire, it covers the full Thaumaturgy system — research, wand crafting, Vis management, and ritual circles.$(br2)The Grimoire is craftable if lost — check JEI for the recipe under its mod tab.
